narrative.overview: The site reads like the technical datasheet of a component family: numbered positions, spec tables, hairline rules, a mono caption over every value. Each project is an item in an index, not a card in a gallery; its facts sit in a key/value table exactly as they would in a part's spec sheet. The visitor reads data, not adjectives. The mood is precise and restrained: generous whitespace, one accent, no decoration that does not carry information. The only ornaments are functional ones that belong to the datasheet world: a faint drafting grid behind the hero, a generative circuit plate per project, and a running release ticker. Dark mode is the same sheet printed in negative.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink and one signal colour; status colours only as 8 px dots.
Three type voices: wide grotesk for names, humanist sans for prose, mono for every label and number.
Square corners everywhere, hairline and 2 px ink rules instead of boxes and shadows.
Numbered index rows with a fixed column grid (number, plate, text, spec).
Motion only where it signals life: ticker, a flowing trace on hover, a short reveal.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange is the only chromatic accent; it marks liveness and newness and covers a few percent of any screen. Status colours never grow beyond their dot.

rules.name: The Small-Text Ink Rule
rules.body: Orange text at body or label size always uses Signal Ink, never Signal Orange; Signal Orange is for fills, strokes, glyphs and display-size marks.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Every number, date, version, key and navigational link is set in JetBrains Mono; prose never is.

rules.name: The Wide-for-Names Rule
rules.body: Unbounded is reserved for names (the wordmark, section titles, project titles, the contact address, board figures). Never for running text or labels.

rules.name: The Shared Column Rule
rules.body: Everything that lists projects or releases sits on the index grid; a new list aligns to number / plate / text / spec rather than inventing its own columns.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. If something needs separation, draw a rule; if it needs emphasis, invert it to ink or mark it with Signal Orange.

dos: Do keep every corner square (0 radius); only status dots and plate pads are round.
Do use Signal Ink (#c4380f light / #ff8a63 dark) for any orange text smaller than display size.
Do set every label, number, date, version and nav link in JetBrains Mono, and every name in Unbounded.
Do separate content with rules (1 px Rule hairlines, 2 px Ink section rules), not with boxes or shadows.
Do place new lists of projects or releases on the index grid (48 / 132 / fluid / 300 px, 32 px gaps).
Do give every motion a reduced-motion fallback and keep the page complete without JavaScript and in print.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, gradients on surfaces, or rounded cards.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or use status colours beyond their 8 px dot.
Don't imitate the projectugarte.com look: centred hero with pill badge, soft rounded cards, generic portfolio grid.
Don't use publisher or game logos and brand imagery for projects built around other companies' games.
Don't set prose or summaries in mono, or labels in Unbounded.
